verdict.rationale: Elasticsearch's core interface is DSL/API-based rather than natural language, but it ships an official MCP server (elastic/mcp-server-elasticsearch) confirmed via a real runtime probe to complete a keyless stdio JSON-RPC handshake, letting AI agents translate natural-language requests into Elasticsearch operations, plus official 'skills' docs for AI coding agents to work with the stack. This is agent-mediated NL control rather than a native NL command layer in the product itself. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language query interface built into Elasticsearch/Kibana itself, and independent hands-on evidence of end-to-end NL-to-result usage beyond the MCP handshake probe.
